testCase.name: [local] S27 Medication changes are never silently lost: extraction or parse fails, or the physician reloads or leaves right after Generate (both modes)

descriptionHtml:
Bug B03 · P0 · new

A medication hold dictated before Generate is silently lost if the page reloads or the app closes before extraction finishes: the drug still shows active, no message (both settings)

Tickets: TFA-92597 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S27 Medication changes are never silently lost: extraction or parse fails, or the physician reloads or leaves right after Generate (both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U22 A medication change is never silently lost: if medication extraction or the pre-round parse fails, the typed or dictated text is kept, the rows stay as they were and a clear message says what failed; … (UAT 3.5 (retry, backup model or a clear message; the physician taps Generate and can move to the next patient); UAT Empty & Failure States (nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost; applies to every TC))
  • T9 No dictated medication or medication change is silently dropped, including in a long dictation with many drugs and several changes. (TFA-94229 R9 (Principle 2); UAT TC-19 (the tracker shows the medications the physician dictated); TFA-92597 What (keep the tracker current))
  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on … (UAT TC-19; TFA-92597 What; TFA-92597 AC 3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Local stack, fresh @roundai.test physician; Hospital patient with Apixaban 5 mg BID active, Nursing Home resident with Metformin 500 mg BID active; model calls answered at the socket (trackActionRequests), one of them failing where the cell says so

When (a) Hospital: Save & Extract 'Hold the apixaban, procedure tomorrow.' with ai/parsing:extractMedicationEvents rejecting, then Save & Extract again with a working answer. (b) Hospital: pre-round Save Note with ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes rejecting. …

Then (a) the encounter text stays in the box, the rows deep-equal the rows before, and a visible message names medications; the retry gives exactly one Held apixaban row. (b) Medications panel rows unchanged, the pre-round error message shown, the raw text kept. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U22 / T9: a dictated change is either in the rows or named in an explicit message, never silently missing; the original text is never lost. The existing lane-A test 'Save & Extract keeps task updates when medication extraction fails' (S04) covers only (a)'s message and the saved notes. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92597 ready for qa; TFA-94229 in progress

A medication hold dictated before Generate is silently lost if the page reloads before the medication extraction finishes: the drug stays 'active' and nothing tells the physician the hold was not saved, in both Nursing Home and Hospital.

Evidence: Allure 55c3cfe9, newspec-c. Part (c), NH, failed in 4 runs; part (d-reload), Hospital, failed in 2 runs. The control run without a reload shows Held. EncounterTab.tsx starts extractEncounterMedications only after onNext(), and useNoteGeneration saves the note before the med follow-up. This breaks TC-19 U22 (UAT 3.5 / Empty & Failure States). generateNote was mocked, pending Quinn's OK. Not in the dev report or ledger.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-19 Medication Tracker · Section: A4 · Post-Round · Scenario: TC-19/S27

Medication changes are never silently lost: extraction or parse fails, or the physician reloads or leaves right after Generate (both modes)

Tickets: TFA-92597 Medication Tracker (ready for qa); TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (newspec-c/plan.json, automatable: yes): New Playwright spec, four tests, model calls answered at the socket. (a) Hospital Apixaban active: Save & Extract with extractMedicationEvents failing -> text kept in the box and stored, rows deep-equal before, message names medications; retry with a hold answer -> exactly one Held apixaban row. (b) pre-round Save Note with parsePreRoundNotes failing -> rows unchanged, error shown, raw text kept. (c) Nursing Home Metformin active: type the hold, Generate Note & Finish with generateNote answered (mock note) and extractMedicationEvents answered after a delay; reload as soon as the note renders -> metformin Held with 'poor intake', or an explicit message. (d) Hospital: Generate with the hold, leave to the patient list before extraction resolves, reopen -> Held or an explicit message. (d-reload, added after review): Hospital, reload the moment the note is stored on the server while the extraction is in flight (U22 names reloading as well as leaving). — All four are scripted UI flows with socket-level answers and JWT row reads. Generate is pressed only against a mocked generateNote (no model call, nothing generated on the server); capabilities.json still lists 'generate' as forbidden locally, so the patch asks Quinn to confirm that a socket-mocked Generate press is allowed. Review: 'generate' stays in needs in the patch until Quinn confirms socket-mocked presses.

Detail:

Re-run 16:54 JST after review, (c) now 4 runs, (d-reload) 2 runs. (a) pass: extraction fails -> 'Notes saved, but medication extraction failed. Tap again to retry.', text kept in the box and stored, rows unchanged; retry -> exactly one 'Held' apixaban row. (b) pass: parse fails -> 'Note saved, but the structured summary couldn't be updated…', raw text kept and stored, rows unchanged. (c) FAIL: Nursing Home 'Hold metformin, poor intake.' -> Generate Note & Finish (note mocked), reload the moment the note renders (extraction answered after 4 s like a model call) -> metformin stays 'active', no message anywhere. Control without the reload: 'Held · Oct 14 (Metformin held, poor intake)', so the mock is valid and the loss is the reload. (d) pass: Hospital, leave to the list right after Generate, reopen -> apixaban Held. (d-reload, added after review; U22 names reloading): Hospital, reload once the note is stored on the server while the extraction is in flight (the screen still shows 'Generating Note…') -> apixaban stays 'active', chart status stays 'seen' with the note stored and the course timeline 'Oct 14: Encounter done', no message: FAIL. Generate pressed only against a mocked generateNote; 'generate' stays in the patch's needs until Quinn confirms that is allowed.

Product issue: A medication hold dictated before Generate Note & Finish is silently lost if the page reloads (or the app is closed and reopened) before the medication extraction returns, in both care settings. Nursing Home: the physician dictates 'Hold metformin, poor intake.', taps Generate, sees the finished note, and on a reload right then metformin still shows active with no message (EncounterTab.tsx starts 'void extractEncounterMedications()' only after onNext(), i.e. after the note is shown). Hospital: the same with 'Hold the apixaban, procedure tomorrow.' when the reload lands after the note is saved but while the screen still says 'Generating Note…' (useNoteGeneration saves the note, then runs the medication follow-up): apixaban stays active, the course says 'Encounter done', nothing says the hold was not saved. Leaving via the app's own back button is fine in Hospital (the page keeps running). Breaks U22 (UAT 3.5: tap Generate and move on; Empty & Failure States: nothing dictated is lost) and T9.

Evidence: 8 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our scripted spec, not written yet): it fails ai/parsing actions on purpose and answers generateNote at the socket (trackActionRequests failFirst, fault-ai), on a fresh local account; dev has no action mock, no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 20…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
